transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess I’m here because I’ve just been feeling really low for a long time. Like, for the last couple years it’s been this heavy, empty feeling that doesn’t really go away, even when I’m at work or at church or around people I care about. It’s just kind of always there.
During the past two years, have there been any stretches of two months or longer when you did not feel this low?

No, not really. I can’t think of any stretch that long where I felt okay. It’s been going on about two years and four months now, since I had to stop taking community college classes because of money and my work schedule.
During this time, have there ever been periods when your depression got much worse for at least two weeks at a time?

It’s been pretty steady, honestly. I mean, I feel low basically all the time, like that heavy, empty feeling is just there whether I’m at work or at church or around people. I don’t know if I’d say it suddenly got much worse for two weeks—I just don’t really feel like it lifts.
During this time, have you often felt bad about yourself?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I mean, I don’t feel great about myself a lot of the time, but I haven’t really thought about it as a separate thing. It’s more just this general low feeling.
During this period, have you often felt worthless or like you’re not good enough?
I don’t know if I’d call it “worthless.” I do feel like I’m not doing enough or I’m falling short a lot, but it’s hard to separate that from just feeling low all the time.
Do you find yourself still dwelling a lot on having to stop your community college classes?
I don’t know. I mean, I think about it sometimes, but I’m not sure I’d say I dwell on it a lot. It’s just one of those things that feels disappointing when it comes up.
Have you been low on energy a lot of the time during this period?

Yeah. A lot of the time I feel like I just don’t have enough energy for normal stuff. Even filling out inspection logs at work, or driving to basketball, or just washing my hair can feel like too much. And even when I rest on my days off, it doesn’t really feel like I get my energy back.
Have you often had trouble concentrating?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed concentration being a main problem, I guess. Some days I’m slower or I have to reread things, but I don’t know if that’s “often” or just normal for me lately.
During this period, have you often had a poor appetite or eaten much more than usual?

Yeah, pretty often. Most days I either don’t eat until my shift is almost over because nothing sounds good, or I end up getting vending machine snacks late because I’m just drained. My weight kind of goes up and down too—like my work pants fit different from month to month.
During this time, have you often had trouble sleeping, or slept much more than usual?

Yeah, I do. I’ll be completely exhausted after standing on the production floor all day, but then when I get in bed my mind just keeps going over everything I’m behind on. And even when I do fall asleep, I wake up feeling like I barely rested.
Does your low mood mostly come up when you think about having to stop college, or is it there even when you’re not thinking about that?

It’s there even when I’m not thinking about college. That made things worse, but honestly for the last couple years I’ve just felt low most of the time. Even at work, or at church, or around people I care about, there’s still this heavy, empty feeling that doesn’t really go away.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I mean… I don’t think I have anything clear to say about hurting myself. Sometimes I just feel really tired of everything, but I don’t know beyond that.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead?
I don’t know… I don’t think I’ve had that exact thought clearly. It’s more like I feel worn out and stuck sometimes, but I’m not sure I’d say I think I’d be better off dead.
During this time, have you often felt like you’re not good enough?

I’m not sure. I mean, I don’t usually think of it in those exact words. I just feel off a lot, like I’m not doing as well as I should, but I don’t know if that’s the same as feeling “not good enough.”
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I still do some of the things I usually like, but I don’t know if I enjoy them the same way. I haven’t really paid close attention to that.
At any point during the past two years, was there ever a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed nearly all day, almost every day?

Yes. Honestly, that’s kind of why I’m here. For the last couple years I’ve felt low almost all the time, like it’s just this heavy, empty feeling that stays there even when I’m at work or at church or around people I care about. It doesn’t really lift much.
During this time, have you often felt hopeless?

Yeah… I guess I have. It’s more like this low, heavy empty feeling that’s been there for the last couple years. Even when I’m at work or at church or with people I care about, it doesn’t really lift much, so it does start to feel pretty hopeless.
During this time, have you often had low self-esteem?
I’m not sure. I mean, I don’t feel great about myself a lot of the time, but I haven’t really thought about whether it’s low self-esteem exactly. It’s hard to separate from just feeling low.
During the times you’ve felt this low, have you often had little interest or pleasure in doing things?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I still do things, but I don’t always know if I’d call it interest or pleasure. A lot of the time I’m just kind of going through the motions.
Lately, have you often found that things you usually enjoy don’t feel enjoyable anymore?
I don’t know for sure. I’ve noticed I don’t get much out of things sometimes, but I’m not sure if that means I don’t enjoy them anymore or if I’m just tired or distracted.
